## About Me

I am a fourth-year computing science student at Simon Fraser University, combining a background in molecular biology and biochemistry. My coursework in machine learning, statistical learning, and computational biology has inspired a strong interest in how machine learning can be applied to genomic data and biological sequence modeling. I am particularly curious about exploring long-range sequence dependencies and computational tools in genomics. I aspire to bridge the gap between wet-lab biology and data-driven systems.

## Research Interest

- **Computational Genomics & Representation Learning:** Evaluating long-range biological sequence models and synteny-aware architectures.
- **Sequence Surveillance:** Applying machine learning workflows to identify functional genomic variations and resistance determinants.
- **Pangenomic Data Analysis:** Developing unsupervised machine learning pipelines to resolve taxonomic boundaries and isolate genetic drivers.

## Education

- **B.Sc. in Computing Science** — Simon Fraser University *(Expected Grad. 2026/2027)* 
- **B.Sc. in Molecular Biology and Biochemistry** — Simon Fraser University
